report_title: Floor Guard AI — Classwise 12-Hazard Model Training Telemetry

floor_mat_hazard.target_features: Curled mat corners, raised carpet lips, folded rugs, displaced runners

floor_damage.target_features: Fractured tiles, broken concrete, craters, expansion joint chipping

water_spill.target_features: Transparent fluid pools, specular reflectance glints, spreading puddles

oil_spill.target_features: Viscous petroleum, dark amber motor oil, machinery fluid leaks

chemical_spill.target_features: Toxic industrial fluids, fluorescent coolants, hazmat leaks

broken_glass.target_features: Shattered shards, sharp fragments, bottle clusters

cable_cord.target_features: Trailing power extension cords, computer wires, tangled cords

obstacle_debris.target_features: Warehouse crates, wooden pallets, dropped boxes, transit obstructions

trash_litter.target_features: Plastic bottles, cans, paper wrappers, rolling slip hazards

food_waste.target_features: Dropped food scraps, fruit peels, sauce splatters, organic waste

mud_dirt.target_features: Wet muddy footprints, tracked soil, loose grit and gravel

stairs_hazard.target_features: Wet slippery step edges, stairwell pooling, step obstructions
